items.label: MA-AG administrative: Quick Temp., Inc.
items.detail: Fair Labor Division citations for prevailing wage, minimum wage, overtime, earned sick leave and records violations; date is the announcement date. The $1392665 in restitution and civil fines is stated for the company, its owner Thomas Lauzon and manager Paul Long together and is not split; the individuals are left out; release says nothing on admission. | Not counted in the total. Shared total, split not stated by the source: counted for no company, kept in gross (overlap group shared-ma-ag-2023-quick-temp; listed under Amounts not counted).

excluded_amounts.reason: Shared total, split not stated: Company, owner and manager share one total; no per-respondent amount and no restitution versus fine split. Citations announced, not shown paid. Source (read 2026-10-11): "citations against Quick Temp., Inc., its owner, Thomas Lauzon, and manager, Paul Long, totaling $1,392,665, in restitution and civil fines". The primary document gives one total for payers that include anyone outside the company, so the total is counted for no company; the row stays in gross (overlap group shared-ma-ag-2023-quick-temp; data/manual/shared-allocations.csv).
